description: Establish the audit baseline: create the feature branch, confirm the doc-validation gates run green at HEAD so later diffs are attributable, inventory the exact current audit numbers (file/line counts, OpenAPI served/target-only counts, SDD package statuses), and record the starting A-xx/B-xx/RV-xx allocations. This is the environment-setup feature: it does NOT modify any product doc; it only proves the baseline and captures ground-truth numbers the later phases depend on. No competitor clones yet.
steps: From /projects/sandbox/litecowork (already cloned, branch main, clean, HEAD 2e85f03 - DO NOT re-clone), create and checkout a feature branch named docs/audit-competitor-superset. Confirm `git status` is clean before and `git branch --show-current` reports the new branch.

Run the doc-validation gates and capture their current output verbatim into .agents/tasks/task-docs-audit-competitor-superset/baseline.md: python3 scripts/audit_v1_markdown.py ; python3 scripts/audit_v1_design_depth.py ; python3 scripts/validate_architecture.py ; python3 scripts/validate_design_owner_consistency.py ; python3 scripts/audit_v1_contracts.py ; python3 .specify/scripts/validate_feature_package.py ; python3 corpus_audit.py. If a script requires the Rust toolchain, prefix with: TMPDIR=/tmp PKG_CONFIG_SYSROOT_DIR=/tmp/sysroot PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/tmp/sysroot/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/pkgconfig LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/sysroot/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu. If corpus_audit.py or any script cannot run in this sandbox, record the exact error and which gate it blocks in baseline.md (do not treat as task failure).

In baseline.md record the ground-truth numbers the audit scripts actually report RIGHT NOW: total active markdown files + line counts from audit_v1_design_depth.py and build_active_corpus_inventory.py, the OpenAPI operation counts (served / authenticated-local-only / target-only) from audit_v1_contracts.py and docs/schemas/served-route-inventory.json, and the SDD package pass count. Note any delta from the numbers CURRENT-RUN.md currently prints (it cites 54,687/54,599; the briefing says generators report 54,701/54,613 - confirm which is true now).

Record in baseline.md the next-unused global IDs confirmed by grep: contradiction/alignment next = A-51 (highest existing A-50), blocking-decision next = B-34 (highest existing B-33), research-gate next = RV-13 (highest existing RV-12). These are reserved for Phases 1-3.

Do NOT edit any doc under docs/ or specs/ in this feature. Commit only the .agents/tasks/** plan files and baseline.md with a message like 'chore(docs-audit): establish audit baseline and gate snapshot'.
acceptance_criteria: A feature branch docs/audit-competitor-superset exists and is checked out; `git branch --show-current` prints it.

.agents/tasks/task-docs-audit-competitor-superset/baseline.md exists and records: each doc-gate command's result (pass/fail/blocked with exact error), the current file/line counts, the OpenAPI served/target-only counts, the SDD package pass count, and the confirmed next-unused A-51/B-34/RV-13 IDs.
No file under docs/ or specs/ is modified by this feature (verify with `git diff --name-only main -- docs specs` being empty).
The plan files and baseline.md are committed on the feature branch.
verification: Run `git branch --show-current` and confirm it prints docs/audit-competitor-superset.
Run `git diff --name-only main -- docs specs` and confirm empty output.
Re-run python3 scripts/audit_v1_markdown.py and confirm its result matches what baseline.md recorded.
Confirm baseline.md contains the served/target-only OpenAPI counts and the A-51/B-34/RV-13 reservations.
findings: Branch docs/audit-competitor-superset created off main (HEAD 2e85f03), clean tree. All doc gates run GREEN at HEAD via the pinned uv env (`uv run --locked python <script>`); system python3 (3.11) lacks yaml/jsonschema/openapi-spec-validator, so the locked uv env is required. uv's default data dir (/root/.local/share/uv) is read-only in this sandbox; redirect with UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/uv-cache UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR=/tmp/uv-python XDG_DATA_HOME=/tmp/uv-data TMPDIR=/tmp before `uv sync --locked` (installs jsonschema 4.26.0, openapi-spec-validator 0.9.0, pyyaml 6.0.3; .venv is gitignored). No cargo build needed for doc gates. Gate results: audit_v1_markdown PASS (255 files/54613 lines/0 broken links at HEAD); audit_v1_design_depth PASS (258 files/54701 lines, 229 routes=173 served+56 target-only, 11 packages, 0 findings); validate_architecture PASS (148 typed events); validate_design_owner_consistency PASS (0 issues, 36 assertions); audit_v1_contracts PASS (openapi=229 served=173 outside=1 target=56); validate_feature_package PASS (11/11 structural); corpus_audit.py at repo root RUNS exit 0 but reports 0 files/0 lines due to a hardcoded Windows base_dir (C:\Users\Sonali\...) — a script-portability bug, not a sandbox blocker and not a task failure; ground-truth taken from scripts/ gates instead. OpenAPI confirmed: 173 served / 1 authenticated-local-only (served_outside_openapi) / 56 target-only = 229 total, matching served-route-inventory.json v3. SDD: 11 packages pass (001 IN_REVIEW, 002-011 DRAFT). Confirmed line-count drift: CURRENT-RUN.md cites 54,687 (design-depth) and 54,599 (markdown) but generators now report 54,701 and 54,613 (+14 each) — a known A-type danger to reconcile in a later phase, NOT here. Next-unused IDs grep-confirmed: A-51 (max A-50), B-34 (max B-33), RV-13 (max RV-12). IMPORTANT follow-on findings for later phases: (1) the markdown audit walks from repo root and does NOT exclude .agents/, so plan/baseline markdown inflates its count (this 113-line baseline.md takes it to 256/54726); reconcile against that offset. (2) The .agents/ directory is ignored by a GLOBAL gitignore (/root/.config/git/ignore), so plan files must be force-added (`git add -f`) to be committed. (3) audit_v1_markdown.py and validate_design_owner_consistency.py rewrite docs/audit/* even without --write, producing LF-vs-CRLF line-ending-only diffs on this Linux host; these were reverted so FEAT-001 touches no docs/ file. git diff --name-only main -- docs specs is EMPTY. No competitor repos cloned (repo_take/ not created).
